coordinates.units: source fields: native crop pixels; assembly fields: common canvas pixels
coordinates.bbox: x,y,width,height; original region edges are right/bottom exclusive
coordinates.rest_pose_note: Source rest rotation is retained. assembly.rotation_deg is the additional clockwise rotation applied at assembly time.
coordinates.pivot_note: Anatomical rotation points are visually estimated rigging anchors, not original authoring metadata.
coordinates.crop_note: Original non-arm sprites retain native crops. Four arm PNGs were segmented and resized uniformly from arm_sheet_20261030; source_rect_px is a source sheet region, not a lossless crop.

arm_sheet_20261030.note: 4 replacement arms only. Original source was opaque RGB with black background; the new PNGs use reconstructed transparent alpha.

blue/arm_left.source_operation: foreground isolation; alpha reconstruction; uniform resampling; 4px transparent padding

blue/arm_right.source_operation: foreground isolation; alpha reconstruction; uniform resampling; 4px transparent padding

black/arm_left.source_operation: foreground isolation; alpha reconstruction; uniform resampling; 4px transparent padding

black/arm_right.source_operation: foreground isolation; alpha reconstruction; uniform resampling; 4px transparent padding

assembly_spec.scale_policy: Normalize torso widths to 312. Four replacement arms share ~160px visible widths and 226px heights, with uniform XY per-part scale and no warping.
assembly_spec.matrix_convention: matrix_2x3 maps native crop pixel coordinates directly to canvas pixels; column-vector convention
assembly_spec.hierarchy_formula: child_local_matrix = inverse(parent_canvas_matrix) * child_canvas_matrix; recompute child_canvas_matrix = parent_canvas_matrix * child_local_matrix when animating
assembly_spec.inheritance: Use either canvas matrix directly OR the parent-local matrix hierarchy, never both. Do not multiply scale_correction again after applying matrix_2x3.
assembly_spec.calibration: Manually calibrated against the original assembled chibi reference; pivots and sockets are reconstruction estimates, not recovered authoring data.
assembly_spec.shared_parts_policy: Reuse the same head and leg transforms for both nations; no raster duplication.
usage_ko: PNG를 리사이즈하여 저장하지 마세요. 원본 픽셀은 그대로 두고 렌더링 때만 배율을 적용합니다.
간단한 조립은 assemblies의 canvas_matrix_2x3와 z_index를 사용합니다.
관절 애니메이션은 parent와 local_matrix_2x3를 사용합니다. 행렬에 배율이 포함되어 있으므로 scale_correction을 다시 곱하지 마세요.
크롭 좌표와 pivot_px는 원본 픽셀 단위이며, position_px는 640×800 공통 캔버스 단위입니다.
조립 좌표와 관절축은 원본 캐릭터를 참고해 보정한 추정값입니다.
